description:
Send files, photos and clipboard between your phone and your PC over local Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing to install on the phone.

Flitdrop is a free AirDrop alternative for Windows, Mac and Linux. Send photos, videos, files, links and the clipboard between any iPhone or Android phone and your computer, both ways, over your own Wi-Fi.
Scan a QR code once and the phone stays paired. Transfers are end-to-end encrypted, with no account and no cloud, and nothing to install on the phone: it uses its browser.
